description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command: set -euo pipefail; export SRC=/gt/_work/src OUT=/gt/_work/out WORK=/gt/_work/work ARCHITECTURE=x86_64; export SANITIZER=address; export CC=clang CXX=clang++; export CFLAGS="-O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer"; export CXXFLAGS="-O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer"; export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer,address"; mkdir -p "$OUT" "$WORK" "$WORK/lib"; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; ar rcs "$WORK/lib/libFuzzingEngine.a"; export LIBRARY_PATH="$WORK/lib:${LIBRARY_PATH:-}"; rm -rf "$WORK/radare2" "$SRC/radare2"; git clone --quiet --no-hardlinks "$SRC" "$WORK/radare2"; mv "$WORK/radare2" "$SRC/radare2"; cp -a /gt/runtime_support/ossfuzz_project/. "$SRC"/; rm -rf "$SRC/radare2-fuzz"; cp -a /gt/runtime_support/radare2-fuzz "$SRC/radare2-fuzz"; cd "$SRC/radare2"; bash /gt/runtime_support/ossfuzz_project/build.sh
